/** * Helper class used for storing mapping from property name to * {@link SettableBeanProperty} instances. *

* Note that this class is used instead of generic {@link java.util.HashMap} * for bit of performance gain (and some memory savings): although default * implementation is very good for generic use cases, it can be streamlined * a bit for specific use case we have. Even relatively small improvements * matter since this is directly on the critical path during deserialization, * as it is done for each and every POJO property deserialized. */ public

/**
     * Convenience method that tries to find property with given name, and
     * if it is found, call {@link SettableBeanProperty#deserializeAndSet}
     * on it, and return true; or, if not found, return false.
     * Note, too, that if deserialization is attempted, possible exceptions
     * are wrapped if and as necessary, so caller need not handle those.
     * 
     * @since 2.5
     */
siblings.name: findDeserializeAndSet
